snippets.description: Idempotent bash-symlink generator .claude/skills and .cursor/skills from source.ai/skills: removes broken symlinks, does not touch real directories (vendor-copies). For projects without Laravel Boost

Example boost.json — generation config Laravel Boost (JSON without comments, so the explanation is here): agents — for which agents to generate (claude_code, cursor); guidelines/mcp — enable rule generation and MCP; packages — third-party packages with guideline-sets; skills — which directories from .ai/skills connect. Generator: php artisan boost:update
Example skills-lock.json — fixing external vendor-skills in .agents/skills: source (owner/repo), sourceType, computedHash; integrity check - npx skills check
